topics.title: Introduction to Kinematics & Motion
topics.subject: physics
topics.overviewConcept: Kinematics is the branch of classical mechanics that describes the motion of points, bodies, and systems of bodies without consideration of the forces acting on them.
competencies: Distinguish between scalar and vector quantities
Calculate average velocity and acceleration from experimental data

sections.heading: Fundamental Principles of Motion
sections.content: Motion is change in position of an object with respect to its surroundings in a given interval of time. Distance is a scalar quantity representing total path length, whereas displacement is a vector quantity representing the shortest straight-line distance from start to finish.

sections.heading: Practical Investigations
sections.content: Using a ticker-timer or motion sensor to record the movement of a trolley down an inclined plane. Measuring dot intervals allows calculation of instantaneous velocity and acceleration.
